title: Split Panel
description: Two panes and a handle — drag it, or tab to it and use the arrow keys.
usage: For editors, mail clients and inspectors: a list on one side, the thing itself on the other. Below two panes, stop — stack instead.
a11y: The divider is a real separator: role="separator" with aria-valuenow for the split percentage, arrow keys to move it, so the layout is adjustable without a pointer.
